scope: Task-24 Phase-1 correctionPlan.fixNow only: GED-A, GED-B, GED-C. No redesign, no other refactoring, no git operations, no doc edits.

corrections.whatChanged: sampleInteractions() (now exported, with exported InteractionSampleResult) counts success as region mounts OR observable state flips. Per clicked trigger it snapshots serialized trigger state before and after the click — aria-expanded / aria-checked / aria-selected / aria-pressed (via closest(), so a wrapping toggle counts), native <details> open (closest('details')), and visibility of every aria-controls target already in the DOM — and increments stateFlips when the snapshots differ. The wr-obs-/wr-dyn- region-mount path is byte-for-byte unchanged for mount-type triggers. The two assertions (interactions-desktop:/ and interactions-mobile:/) now require clicked>0 && (regionsAppeared + stateFlips) > 0 and report all three numbers in the detail string.
corrections.testAdded: smoke:production new section 'interaction sampling: mount-type AND static-target triggers (GED-A)' — 5 real-Chromium fixture checks: mount-type still passes via region mount; native <details> passes as stateFlips=1 with regionsAppeared=0 (the domainchecker false-fail shape); aria-checked selection toggle passes (the nextjs false-fail shape); aria-expanded + aria-controls target-visibility change passes; an inert trigger produces neither regions nor flips (criteria are not trivially satisfiable).

corrections.whatChanged: Blocker construction extracted into exported pure buildPreviewBlockers(PreviewBlockerInputs) — same 7 blocker ids, same order, same evidence-path shapes. Every previously hardcoded literal is now derived from the same in-scope lineage artifacts the evidence paths cite: needs-input total + fallback-title route count (needs-input.json entries matching routes[...].title) / route count (seo plan), replacement-required count (replacement-manifest classification filter) + residual count (network-qa.json totals.residualSourceUrls.length, also replacing the hardcoded 'residual=4' in the evidence string), webfont family names (font-inventory.json license[].family from the materialization's inventoryRunDir), uninjected-route arithmetic + scope (content manifest scopedRoutes vs seo plan route count), inline-svg entry count (inventory manifest counts.inlineSvgEntries). One phrasing change: '4 still render on / from source hosts' became '<n> source-host asset URLs still render in the network census' because the number is census-derived, not /-scoped prose (the aggregation's consistencyFindings flagged the /-scoped phrasing as misleading).
corrections.testAdded: smoke:production new section 'preview blocker summaries derive from inputs (GED-B)' — 8 checks: exact derived summaries for seo/replacement/fonts/uninjected/inline-svg from one input set, a second input set (nextjs-shaped numbers) produces different derived prose, and blocker ids are stable across input sets.

corrections.whatChanged: New exported predicate isFragmentOnlyCssRef(url) in inventory.ts: true for raw fragment-only url(#id) values and for their browser-serialized form where the percent-encoded '#' was resolved into the page URL as a path segment (last path segment starting with %23 — the observed https://nextjs.org/%23b shape). URLs with a real file plus fragment (sprite.svg#icon) are NOT skipped. createAssetInventoryRun filters both ingestion channels (SiteSpec asset-catalog and generated-CSS url() refs) through the predicate before entry assembly and records the skip honestly as counts.fragmentRefsSkipped (inventory counts + manifest counts; schema field optional so all pre-fix inventory artifacts still zod-load). counts.catalogAssets keeps the raw catalog size so the delta is visible.
corrections.testAdded: smoke:assets — fixture lineage gains a 12th catalog asset (kind background-image, url https://fixturebrand.example/%23glow) plus a generated-CSS mask-image:url(...) ref to the same fragment URL; new checks assert entries stay 15, fragmentRefsSkipped === 2, the fragment URL is never inventoried, and 4 predicate unit cases (raw '#b', encoded %23b, sprite.svg#icon negative, plain png negative).
